image.prompt: Premium editorial visual of an AI marketing command centre

storyboard.voiceover: The problem is not ideas. The problem is turning scripts, visuals, timing, voice, and edits into one clean production path.
storyboard.onScreenText: Ideas are easy. Production discipline is the bottleneck.

storyboard.voiceover: Synthex uses Hermes, Remotion, image generation, and one Synthex ElevenLabs voice to create marketing videos with visible production gates. The system creates the script, directs the scenes, checks the edit, keeps one voice, and prepares a render packet before production.
Every job carries timing evidence, a single Synthex ElevenLabs voice policy, and a reproducible Remotion command so the render can be checked instead of guessed.
